source: Muse recheck of first-pass flags; apply through the belt (02 fact block -> 16 -> 04/05 remint), never in place

corrections.corrected_statement: The two written tests are walk-in, but the skills test is appointment-only and is scheduled on the DMV road test web page.
corrections.note: Walk-in rule for written tests is stated on page five, not page six.

corrections.corrected_statement: A sponsor signs form MV3001 for an applicant under 18, and the behind-the-wheel school also supplies a signed MV3001, so the same form number appears twice in the teen path.
corrections.note: The school-supplied MV3001 is stated on page 9, not on cited page 7.

corrections.corrected_statement: In the 5 a.m. to 12 a.m. window a GDL driver may go anywhere alone, but in the 12 a.m. to 5 a.m. window driving alone is allowed only between home, school and work.
corrections.note: The 12 a.m. to 5 a.m. home-school-work limit is stated on page 11, not on cited page 10.

corrections.corrected_statement: In a two lane roundabout to go straight follow the pavement markings arrows or signs.
corrections.note: Removed middle lane rule not found on provided pages.

corrections.corrected_statement: The Driver Education Grant Program lets teens who are income eligible have their classroom or behind the wheel driver training or both paid for by the state.
corrections.note: Corrected and to either or both to match and/or on the page.

corrections.corrected_statement: A Sharp Turn sign can point left or right and asks you to be ready to slow for the turn, unlike a Curved Road sign, which marks a gradual bend.
corrections.note: Curved Road description is on page 27, not page 26.

corrections.corrected_statement: A Merge sign shows a lane joining from the right or left, while a Lane Ends sign shows your own lane ending; in both cases you move over when it is safe.
corrections.note: Lane Ends description is on page 26, not page 27.

corrections.corrected_statement: Reduced Speed Ahead means you should slow down because there might be a curb or slippery road ahead.
corrections.note: Removed unverified yellow warning claim not on cited or adjacent pages.

corrections.corrected_statement: In that two lane example the far left lane is for left turns only and the right lane is for left turns or going straight.
corrections.note: Removed added instruction to always read arrows.

corrections.corrected_statement: Orange construction signs warn you about people working on or near the road.
corrections.note: Removed yellow signs claim not on cited or adjacent pages.

corrections.corrected_statement: Blue signs point to services such as a hospital or camping, while green and brown signs point to destinations.
corrections.note: Green and brown destination description is on page 31, not page 32.
